why: Linewatch is the canary parts consumer: components, rules and setup only, no shell, 31 files on basalt, ~45 on raw Mantine, and a 823 KB main chunk for one Callout.
what: linewatch repo (consumer_repo): web/**, package.json, bun.lock, .basalt/** and the managed root files init and sync write. One PR, codemod commit first, then manual commits clearing the worklist; over 15 files by design (migration-release 6, exception 5).
must_not_touch: any basalt-ui checkout (no hand edits upstream)
collector/**, src/**, drizzle/**, Dockerfile, docker-compose.yml (the API and collector)
contract: Read in ~/SourceRoot/basalt-ui: concepts/migration-release.md sections 5 (G1), 6, 7; evidence/consumer-linewatch.md sections 1, 2, 6.5. Pin exact basalt-ui 3.0.0-next.N, N = floors.G1.next in ~/SourceRoot/basalt-ui/scripts/fleet.json; first run `npm view basalt-ui@3.0.0-next.N version`: if empty, stop and file a signal (the release is the owner's make release). Symbols not frozen at G1 (PageBar, Section, EmptyState, Callout, ViewTabs, BandStrip, Heatmap) are never used: build on ui/* or app code and list each in the PR as a re-point at the bump.
change: Run basalt-ui init --profile parts and migrate --from 2.29.0 --profile parts, then the layout codemod (bun ~/SourceRoot/basalt-ui/tools/migrate-v3/run.ts layout web --report /tmp/linewatch-layout-report.json; the report is an uncommitted worklist) as commit 1. Manifest: web/.basalt/manifest.json (web is the declared root). Then manual commits: StatusBar to StatGroup strip plus StatCell (753 to about 120 lines, keep status-bar.render.test.tsx pins), two hand tables to DataTable (cardsBelow wide; delete table-card-swap.module.css and both minWidths), dashboard-store.ts to defineControls, charts to the v3 kinds and seams, 6 CSS modules to Tailwind @container, drop @mantine/*, shiki, react-markdown. Rule: the generated oxlint preset at app level. Skill: the managed .claude files from sync. Tests: the existing web suite.
commits: Linewatch's own convention (AGENTS.md, commitlint); no attribution. Codemod output is its own commit, then manual commits, one merge.
proof: make check at the linewatch root; basalt-ui shot at 1800x1200 and 390x844 dark and light, at most 3 reviewer rounds.
acceptance: git diff --name-only master...HEAD lists only owned paths (web/**, package.json, bun.lock, .basalt/**, the managed root files init and sync write)
make check exits 0 (frozen installs, format, lint, typecheck, root and web tests)
web test suite: at least 40 test files, all green, incl. the chart contract tests and status-bar.render.test.tsx
web/.basalt/manifest.json declares profile parts; doctor and lint exit 0 from the local bin; lint --stats waivers at or under the fleet.json row ceiling
web/src/lib/{aggregate,kpi,verdicts,api,mock}* differ only in import lines (git diff stat)
web/src/**/table-card-swap.module.css is deleted and no hand-written minWidth remains on the two tables
commit subjects pass linewatch's commitlint (its own tool) and the pinned basalt-ui version resolves on npm
fleet-status --gate G1 shows linewatch green; deploy is make up by the owner, not claimed
out_of_scope: Backend, collector, Docker, deploy, G2 or G3 symbols, basalt-ui edits, pixel baselines. One Issue by design (exception 5).
